purpose: Development-only safety challenge authored before model scoring. Labels are synthetic scenario assumptions, not claims that event identity can always be inferred from the report text. Never use this split as held-out evaluation data.

label_policy.same: The author assigns both reports to one underlying event in the scenario; expected_action attach is a target only when available evidence supports it, not an assertion that text alone proves identity.
label_policy.different: The author assigns reports to distinct underlying events despite identical recorded context; expected_action separate. The input text should not rely on annotation-style “different” or “separate” wording.
label_policy.underdetermined: Available report text cannot establish whether the underlying event is the same; expected_action review and must never auto-attach.

context_policy: Every case pair has exactly the same known zone, sublocation, and reported_at to prevent metadata alone from separating the pair.

right.text: There is an elderly guest down at the south stairs who does not wake when spoken to.
